subject: Request: temporary availability exception for 'Orion' preview launch
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@atlasai.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: SLA availability guidance for Orion preview

Hi Rishi,

We're planning a controlled preview of our Orion LLM integration next month and need to confirm Redwood's availability guarantees for preview builds. AtlasAI's compliance team wants to understand whether we can get a temporary SLA carveout or formal exception for uptime/latency while Orion is in preview.

Specifically:
- Target preview window: Nov 30 – Dec 14 (internal pilot, ~200k tokens/day)
- Expected p95 latency target for production is 220ms, but for preview we anticipate higher variance
- Compliance wants a written note if Redwood can accept a temporary SLO of 95% availability and p95 latency up to 400ms for the preview period, plus a rollback plan if availability drops below 90% for more than one day

I've attached a short QA doc that outlines AtlasAI's audit checklist. Can you loop in the right folks and let me know next steps? If legal needs to be involved, copy them on the next message.

Thanks,
Alyssa
Director, Cloud Partnerships
AtlasAI Inc.

[Attachment: Atlas_requirements_QA.docx (DOCX)]

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@atlasai.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Alyssa — thanks for the clear ask and the doc. I'm looping in Neha (Platform Reliability) and Karthik (Product) to scope the engineering and product impact.

High-level next steps from our side:
- Neha to propose a temporary SLO and operational runbook for the preview window
- Karthik to confirm feature-flag/fallback options (a lighter model variant we can route to automatically)
- If legal needs a formal carveout clause, we'll surface a short addendum for signatures

Neha/Karthik — can one of you propose an operational SLO (availability + latency p95) and attach a short runbook we can share with Atlas? Need this by EOD today so we can give Atlas a yes/no and an outline of mitigations.

Thanks,
Rishi
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference

From: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.com>

On Wed, Nov 11, 2026 at 09:12 AM Alyssa Chen <alyssa@atlasai.com> wrote:
> We're planning a controlled preview of our Orion LLM integration next month and need to confirm Redwood's availability guarantees for preview builds.

Thanks for the context — we reviewed AtlasAI's QA checklist. Technical notes and proposal below. Attaching a short runbook.

Proposal (operational):
- Temporary SLO: 95% availability (measured at customer region ingress) for the preview window Nov 30–Dec 14
- Latency: p95 target of 400ms for text-gen requests on the Orion preview model (we will advertise this as a preview-level SLO)
- Automatic fallback: route to "Orion-lite" (quantized variant) when cluster utilization > 80% or when p95 latency breaches 500ms for 15m
- Incident playbook: on-call pages to platform team at 90% utilization; automated scaling and warm pool activation at 85%
- Rollback: if availability < 90% sustained for 24 hours, we will pause preview routing and migrate Atlas traffic to a compatible stable model (expected < 2 hours to redirect)

Operational caveats:
- These are preview-level commitments — not a GA SLA. We will document them in a short exception addendum for legal.
- We recommend Atlas limits concurrent streaming requests and uses token budget controls to avoid noisy neighbors.

Attachments: orion-preview-runbook.pdf (runbook + escalation matrix) and a short spreadsheet with projected impact.

Let me know if you need finer granularity (per-route SLOs) or scheduled maintenance windows included.

—Neha
Principal Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: orion-preview-runbook.pdf (PDF)]

From: lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.com>

Thanks team — I reviewed Neha's proposal and approve the temporary SLO as written, with these commercial/ops notes: 
- Sales should record this as an exception in the deal record and surface the limited window (Nov 30–Dec 14) on the invoice/contract page
- Legal: please prepare a short addendum that describes the exception as "preview-level commitments" with explicit rollback triggers (Neha's thresholds)
- Customer comms: Rishi, please send Atlas the confirmed SLO + runbook and an outline of the expected behaviors (fallback, maintenance)

I'm comfortable approving the exception provided we log it and limit exposure to the defined window.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
VP, Sales Operations
